5 saatlik pencere bittiğinde Haiku'ya te: When the 5-hour window ends, sends Haiku a one-line request to start the next window early. It gives no extra limit, it only decides when the window starts. Each request uses very few tokens. The request isn't saved to chat history, so it doesn't show up in the Claude app.
Oturum sırasında proje klasörüne attığın: Commit titles you make in the project folder during a session go into the diary and reports. Only your own commits are read and nothing leaves your computer.
Tonti bilgisayarda ne yaptığını not alır: Tonti notes what you do on the computer to fill your diary and reports. Everything stays on this computer and is never sent anywhere.
Hangi dosyada ya da belgede çalıştığını: Shows which file or document you worked on (like "CatPet.swift — ullage-cat"). Only the front window's name is read; it never looks at your keys or screen. Browser titles are not stored.
Tarayıcıda hangi sitede ne kadar kaldığı: Keeps how long you stay on each site by domain only (like youtube.com). Page titles, full URLs and contents are not stored; private windows are skipped.
Yapay zekâ araçlarıyla çalıştığın proje: Counts changes per hour in the project folders you use with AI tools. File names and contents are not stored.
GitHub > Settings > Developer settings >: GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Fine-grained tokens: select only this profile repo and grant Contents: Read and write. The token stays only in this computer's Windows Credential Manager.

Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigrav: Once you start using Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, Kimi or Cline, Tonti fills this in by itself. See which ones are missing in Settings → Providers.

Pencere, menü ve görev çubuğundaki göste: The window, the menu and the taskbar indicator change together.
Görev çubuğunda ve popover'da görünecek: Choose which providers appear in the taskbar and popover.
